title: 3-Step Process for EVERY Job Application 🔎 #jobapplication
description:
Running an efficient job search means having great processes in place. When it comes to job applications you always want to do three things. First, save the job so you can quickly revisit it later. Second, apply to the job using your latest resume tailored for the postition. Third, save the contacts related to the application. #jobsearchtips #jobapplicationtips
